movelist.name: Block
movelist.effect: The target is Stuck and Trapped until the beginning of your next turn.

movelist.name: Rest
movelist.effect: The user is set to their full Hit Point value. The user is cured of any Status ailments. Then, the user falls Asleep. The user cannot make Sleep Checks at the beginning of their turn. They are cured of the Sleep at the end of their turn in 2 rounds.

movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: Harden
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Defense 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Magnet Pull
abilities.effect: Pick Two Effects; - The target is pushed or pulled X meters directly away or towards the user. X is up to 6 meters minus the target’s Weight Class. - Until the end of the user’s next turn, the target may not move more then 6 meters away from the user . - Until the end of the user’s next turn, the target may not move closer than 3 meters ot the user.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.effect: While on sandy terrain or in Sandstorms, the user’s Ground, Rock, and Steel-Typed damaging moves deal +5 Damage.
